Guillermo's own take for Wed, Oct 28 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Quiet, grey one after last night’s southerly. At 5am Pam Rocks reads NNE 7, the English Bay buoy ENE 6 and Pemberton is level with Vancouver. Nothing on the page tops 30%.

If you need a session, my best guess is Tsawwassen, south side, from 5pm to last light around 6:20, SE 8 to 10. Tide is 13 to 14ft, so plenty of water. Environment Canada has east 10 to 15 late, ahead of the page. Go if Sand Heads swings SE and reads 12+ by 4pm.

Wind northerly outflow 10 to 15 knots diminishing to light early this afternoon then increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 early this evening. Wind increasing to northerly outflow 25 to 35 overnight then diminishing to northerly outflow 20 near noon Thursday. Wind increasing to northerly outflow 25 to 35 Thursday evening.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 AM PCT 28 October 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Today Tonight and Thursday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northwest 5 to 15 knots becoming light this morning then increasing to southeast 10 to 15 late this afternoon. Wind increasing to east 15 to 25 after midnight then becoming easterly 15 Thursday afternoon.
